bugs.text: The player never respawns. On death or capture playerAlive is set false and readyTimer=1.5, but no code sets playerAlive=true when the timer expires (it is only set at game start and stage start). With no player, dives are not scheduled (1439) and the stage cannot be cleared, so the game soft-locks until the page is reloaded; Enter does nothing outside the attract state (1916-1918). The play-test screenshots from 8 s to the end show exactly this: full idle formation, no fighter, one reserve ship, score 0.

Because of the missing respawn, every tractor-beam follow-up is unreachable: rescue, dual fighter, captive firing, and destroying the captive in formation all require a live player after a capture (or an existing dual fighter, which itself needs a rescue).

Entering enemies fire from the first frame (fireTimer starts at 0-1.5 s, 'entering' is a firing state) with up to 24 bullets on screen; screenshot 2-after-enter-5s shows about 25 bullets at once while the player is still in the READY delay and cannot shoot (716). Combined with the respawn bug the automated run lost its only effective life within 8 s.
Stage badges only appear when the stage number equals a denomination; stages are not decomposed into 50/30/20/10/5/1 flags, so the badge row does not show the stage count.
Capture has no animation: the ship disappears instantly and is drawn above the boss the same frame; the spec's pull-up is missing.
Escort Goei teleport from their formation slot to the boss's side the moment a boss dive starts, instead of flying out with it.
Challenging-stage enemies cross the screen on a sine wiggle rather than the looping patterns the spec asks for.
startStage resets playerShips to 1, so a dual fighter would be lost between stages (moot given it is unreachable).
A freed ship targets the player's position at the moment of release and docks when it reaches that Y regardless of where the player has moved (moot given it is unreachable).
The 'enemyHit' sound is defined but never played; boss first hit uses bossHit and all kills use enemyDestroyed.
P does nothing during the STAGE N intro or game-over screens; pause only works in playing/challenging/challengeResults.

summary: The code is tidy and well organised: a proper fixed-timestep loop, clear state/update/render separation, string-data sprites, synthesized Web Audio with a sustained beam tone, a complete attract screen, HUD, localStorage high score, two-hit Boss with colour change, escorted dives whose score depends on live escorts, a widening animated tractor beam, and a full challenging-stage scoring and results screen. It looks like Galaga at a glance and the play-test loads with no console errors. But one omission undoes it: the player is never respawned after a death or capture, so the game offers exactly one life and then freezes with an idle formation (the screenshots show this from 8 s on), and that same hole makes the whole signature mechanic (rescue, dual fighter, captive gunfire) unreachable. Entry flights are scattered singles rather than grouped trains, challenging-stage paths are sine wiggles rather than loops, stage badges follow the wrong rule, and the sprites are plain blobs. Faithful in structure and rules, but not in play.
